title: MICA self_test_policy Expansion v0.2.0 — Package Completeness Checks
description: Additive patch to v0.1.8.1 selfTestCheck.$defs. Adds 7 new check_type values and 1 new severity value (info). All existing check_types and severities are unchanged. This document is the normative spec for the package-completeness check axis.

changes.note: info = legacy detection / alignment status. No action required. Existing values (warning, error, critical) unchanged.

severity_tier_mapping.description: 3-tier severity model for package completeness checks. Clarifies when to fail hard vs warn vs log.

critical.label: hard-fail
critical.meaning: Contract is broken. Session cannot proceed in a trustworthy state.
examples: declared archive path does not exist

error.label: warning-block
error.meaning: Contract is incomplete. Session can proceed but operator must acknowledge.
examples: mode mismatch between mica.yaml and archive

warning.label: drift-signal
warning.meaning: Contract exists but version axes are misaligned. Readable but not machine-verified.
examples: mica_spec mismatch between mica.yaml and archive

info.label: legacy-status
info.meaning: Legacy state. Fully readable. No action required now; note for next version bump.

mica_yaml_present.description: Verifies that mica.yaml (composition contract) exists at the expected location in this project. Absence means the MICA package has no composition declaration — the fundamental contract is missing.

mica_yaml_fields_valid.description: Verifies that mica.yaml contains required fields: mica_spec, mode, and at least 2 layers (archive + playbook). Catches partially-written mica.yaml that exists but is incomplete.

mica_yaml_paths_exist.description: Verifies that every path declared in mica.yaml layers (where required != false) corresponds to an actual file or directory. A declared path that doesn't exist means the composition contract references a ghost file.

mica_yaml_mode_coherent.description: Verifies that mode-specific required layers are present. memory_injection requires archive + playbook layers. protocol_evolution additionally requires a lessons layer. Mismatch means the declared mode does not match the actual package composition.

mica_spec_present.description: Checks whether the archive JSON contains a mica_spec field. Absence is legacy-valid (COMPAT-001) but signals that the archive is not yet on the v0.2.0 version axis. Not a failure — an alignment status signal.

mica_spec_aligned.description: Verifies that mica.yaml.mica_spec and archive.mica_spec are equal when both are present. When both exist and differ, the package composition contract and the archive body are on different version axes — a machine-detectable drift condition. When archive.mica_spec is absent, this check should not fire (use mica_spec_present instead).
mica_spec_aligned.target_convention: archive JSON mica_spec vs mica.yaml mica_spec

mica_package_complete.description: Umbrella check. Passes only when all of the following are true: mica.yaml exists, required fields are valid, all required layer paths exist, mode coherence is satisfied, and no critical drift signals are present. This is the single check that answers: 'Is this MICA package in a closed, trustworthy contract state?' Recommended as the final check in any self_test_policy block.
mica_package_complete.expression_pattern: mica_yaml_present.pass and mica_yaml_fields_valid.pass and mica_yaml_paths_exist.pass and mica_yaml_mode_coherent.pass
mica_package_complete.target_convention: synthesizes results of all package-completeness checks

composition_completeness.question: Does the mica.yaml composition contract exist and is it well-formed?

path_coherence.question: Do all declared layer paths actually exist on disk?

mode_coherence.question: Does the declared mode have the required layers?

archive_compatibility.question: Is the archive on the v0.2.0 version axis?

drift_signals.question: Are mica.yaml and archive JSON on the same version axis?

recommended_check_ordering.description: Run checks in this order. Hard-fail checks first so the session stops before executing softer checks on a broken base.
order: 3. mica_yaml_paths_exist    (critical  → stop if ghost paths detected)
